system.name: DRAFT
system.one_liner: A framework that lets an LLM refine tool documentation by trial and error with the tool, through experience gathering, learning from experience and documentation rewriting.

content.variant_note: three narrative panels: (a) defects in current documentation on real excerpts, (b) trial-and-error rounds that reveal hidden functionalities, (c) win, tie and lose bars for the improved documentation
content.argues: Tool documentation written for humans is incomplete, redundant or inaccurate for LLMs; repeated trials with the tool repair it, and LLMs prefer the rewritten version.
content.subject: Three documentation defects with their errors, three rounds of an agent exploring a tool, and a stacked bar chart of preference for improved documentation.

lessons.what_to_learn: Tell a problem, a process and a result in one figure: red dashed boxes on a page stack tied by arrows to enlarged excerpts and their errors, the same icon cycle repeated per round while a grid of eyes flips from crossed-out to open, and one stacked bar chart as the verdict.
lessons.suits: papers on agent tooling or documentation quality where defects can be shown on real excerpts and improvement over rounds can be shown with icons.

summary: DRAFT is a framework that lets an LLM refine tool documentation through trial and error with the tool, to repair documentation written for humans. Figure 1 has three tinted panels. (a) A stack of documentation pages with red dashed boxes on defective passages leads by grey arrows to enlarged excerpts, labelled incomplete, redundant and inaccurate, each with a sad robot's question and the error it causes, such as a resource not found or an 'I'm a teapot' return. (b) Three rounds of the same robot-and-icon cycle, with Trial arrows between them, flip a 2x2 grid of eyes from crossed-out to open and end in a smiley. (c) Stacked bars show win, tie and lose shares of the improved against the raw documentation on RestBench-TMDB, RestBench-Spotify and ToolBench.
summary_zh: DRAFT 让大模型通过试错交互改写工具文档。图1分三块：(a)红色虚线框标出不完整、冗余、不准确的文档摘录及报错；(b)机器人三轮试错，眼睛格由划掉变睁开；(c)堆叠条形图显示改进文档的胜平负比例。
notes: Prior kinds (side-by-side-contrast problem-then-fix, stage-pipeline) revised: stage-pipeline is replaced by worked-walkthrough (iteration rounds) and concept-schematic because panel (b) repeats one unlabelled cycle with a changing state instead of handing artifacts between named stages. Which excerpt belongs to which defect is read from border colours; the first two excerpts both carry the blue border (incomplete). The roles of the three logos in (c) are not labelled. Tie and lose percentages for TMDB (5.5%, 2%) and the ToolBench lose value (0.7%) are read from labels with leader lines. The robot count and icon counts are approximate.
